description: Avoid MERGE_UNSUPPORTED by validating the pull request head rather than the ephemeral merge commit
rationale: GitHub pull_request checkout defaults to a merge commit; intent validate rejects merges; pin checkout to head SHA and use --commit HEAD when BASE is empty
requirements: Validate workflow checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha
Empty BASE_SHA uses validate --commit HEAD instead of walking history
title: PR validate checks out head SHA
